title: Zesty Yeasty Egyptian Chicken Wrap
description: A flavorful and energizing Egyptian dish featuring Thai green curry paste, wrapped in a soft and pillowy ssam-wrap, with a Mediterranean twist.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together yeast, olive oil, and 1 cup of warm water to activate the yeast.
Add the chopped onion, minced garlic, and diced tomato to the bowl and mix well.
Add the chicken breast strips to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken until browned and cooked through.
Add the Thai green curry paste to the skillet and stir to combine.
Warm the ssam-wrap pieces by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20 seconds.
Assemble the wraps by spooning the chicken and curry mixture onto the center of each ssam-wrap piece.
Fold the bottom half of the ssam-wrap up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll up the wrap to form a tight cylinder.
